basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and fantasy enthusiast based in Providence, Rhode Island. I've been on Reddit for nearly two decades, exploring everything from gaming strategies to local community news. I’m a software developer by day, working with a major consulting firm, and a spell-slinging wizard by night in games like Spellbreak. Married to my high school sweetheart, we share our home with two mischievous cats. Typical online hours are in the evenings and weekends, when I'm not caught up in code or conjuring spells.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deep knowledge in software development and gaming, primarily self-taught through online courses and extensive gaming experience. My work at a consulting firm has also broadened my understanding of technology trends and client needs.
